description: Defines the RoomImpl class implementing the IRoom interface for managing chat room interactions, including user join/leave notifications, message sending, and callback management within the WPEFramework plugin.

classes.name: RoomImpl
classes.description: Implements a chat room with user join/leave notifications, message sending, and callback handling within the WPEFramework plugin.

methods.name: RoomImpl
methods.description: Constructor initializing room with admin, room ID, user ID, and message sink, managing reference counts.

methods.name: ~RoomImpl
methods.description: Destructor releasing references and cleaning up.

methods.name: SendMessage
methods.description: Sends a message to the room via the admin.

methods.name: SetCallback
methods.description: Registers or unregisters a callback for user notifications.

methods.name: UserJoined
methods.description: Notifies that a user has joined the room.

methods.name: UserLeft
methods.description: Notifies that a user has left the room.
